adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `packages/core/CalendarManager.ts` still does `log.error("createEvent failed", JSON.stringify(error), calEvent)` inside the `createEvent` catch block, which logs the full `CalendarEvent` object. In this PR `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` was changed from a single object to an array (`DestinationCalendar[] | null`), and `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` was changed to iterate over `event.destinationCalendar` and call `createEvent(...)` for each destination/credential. That makes the same full-event (attendees, notes, and now multiple destination calendars/credentialIds) potentially logged repeatedly per failing host/credential, increasing PII exposure. This is a verifiable security/privacy defect grounded in the diff.
